It adds a lot of unrelated documentation and tests around retry internals as well. A at least shares those mechanics through a private add method, though it still does not literally call Add as required assessing code quality and potential defects in the candidate patches only. It also buffers all Add bodies, changing lower-level behavior and potentially increasing memory use. Both patches omit an explicit source-reader failure test; A additionally replaces and weakens some original Add assertions.
